body:
The worker08 source case `CM_NAME:a85d32e4db2ff39c2e5d40027736dd6f2a6bdaf6648ee6e46130ee677f4b789e` names carbon monoxide as `CO` in its recipe context. A proposed global `RAW_TEXT` alias on `Carbon_Monoxide.yaml` was withdrawn after independent review: the current CultureMech `MIMLabelIndex` casefolds that label, so cobalt's symbol `Co` receives the carbon-monoxide identity as well.

Two independent read-only reproductions are preserved under `reports/all_unmatched_20261107/worker-08/`: the reviewer used the native resolver with the exact proposed alias row (`independent/organics-reviews-inorganics/co-casefold-reproduction.json`), then the worker coordinator repeated it against the **complete frozen MIM label index**, appending only that alias in memory (`review-history/co-full-index-overlay-reproduction.json`). Before the addition, both `CO` and `Co` are unresolved; after it, both return `CHEBI:17245`. The current index contains no existing casefold-`co` group. No canonical export was rebuilt or edited.

The resolver is [CultureMech mim_label_index.py at the verified current commit](https://github.com/CultureBotAI/CultureMech/blob/199cd9191881e8e929cd95ea0ed13aabe388e58c/src/culturemech/ingredients/mim_label_index.py), SHA256 `e07eb72fe91743859451d1998dfeafe58a40dad43baa82d710a740c47dc4bf61`. This is a demonstrated hazard of the proposed alias, not a claim that current published MIM already resolves cobalt to carbon monoxide.

Bounded action already taken in this shard: withdraw the global alias proposal and preserve the gas identification only for the exact source occurrence. The carbon-monoxide owner is unchanged. The original proposal and the counterexample remain in review history.

Before introducing this raw global alias, require a reviewed source-specific override or an explicit formula-aware/case-sensitive resolver contract. Its acceptance tests must keep `CO` as carbon monoxide in the supported gas context and prevent `Co` from inheriting that identity, with the complete admitted label index as test input. Preserve existing unmapped/ambiguous decisions and exact source identifiers; do not solve the collision with a generic lowercasing alias or by asserting cobalt is carbon monoxide.

Live all-state MIM casefold/case-sensitive searches found only unrelated filename/sorting issues; the upstream search is retained in this worker's evidence. This issue records the unresolved source-alias admission requirement. No source/owner/export approval, code change, or downstream rebuild is implied.
title: Keep CO source alias on hold until casefold resolution preserves the Co distinction
